notes: Mutable ATO facts. Re-verify at use time. This index is provenance, not a substitute for a live source check.

sources.title: Business activity statements (BAS)
sources.fact: BAS labels, reporting method, and lodgement cycle are read from the entity's statement and current ATO guidance, not assumed.

sources.title: How GST works
sources.fact: GST registration basis (cash or accruals) must match the report basis before any label is mapped.

sources.title: Pay as you go (PAYG) withholding
sources.fact: A large withholder reporting through STP no longer needs to report an amount at W1. That relief is a large-withholder rule, not a rule for every STP reporter. Non-payroll withholding does not all belong at W1/W2: no-ABN withholding sits at its own label (W4 at time of writing) and other amounts withheld sit at W3; the current label set must be confirmed at ato.gov.au before lodging.

sources.title: Activity statement instructions
sources.fact: Simpler BAS entities report G1, 1A and 1B in the GST section where the current turnover test is met. G10/G11 capital vs non-capital mapping follows the entity's reporting method.

sources.title: Simpler BAS and GST bookkeeping: capital purchases
sources.fact: The $1,000 capital-purchases concession applies only where the entity does not record capital and non-capital purchases separately and expects GST turnover below $1 million; in that case capital items of $1,000 or less may be recorded at G11. All conditions and current guidance must be re-verified before applying it.
